# wso2is_claim_dialect (Resource)

Manages an external claim dialect. A dialect is a set of claim URIs that another system uses, such as an identity provider or an older application. Map each claim of the dialect to a local claim with `wso2is_external_claim`. Deleting a dialect also deletes its claims. To import a dialect, use its dialect URI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_claim_dialect" "legacy" {
  dialect_uri = "urn:example:legacy-claims"
}

resource "wso2is_external_claim" "mail" {
  dialect_uri            = wso2is_claim_dialect.legacy.dialect_uri
  claim_uri              = "mail"
  mapped_local_claim_uri = "http://wso2.org/claims/emailaddress"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dialect_uri` (String) Dialect URI, for example `urn:example:claims`. Changing it replaces the dialect.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Dialect ID (base64url of the URI).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_claim_dialect.legacy urn:example:legacy-claims
```
